definition: A parameter written into a rule name or profile entry and replaced by a specific trait, class or other value when the rule is assigned.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Lets one reusable rule family key off a named category rather than requiring separate rules.

definition: A policy governing whether repeated instances of the same special rule combine, overlap or provide no extra benefit.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Defines how duplicate effects interact and prevents ambiguous cumulative bonuses.

definition: A self-contained explosive game piece that triggers when an eligible enemy contacts it and is then removed.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Creates a mobile/contact-triggered hazard rather than a conventional attack.

definition: A limited mine-deployment capability used during deployment rather than as a normal recurring weapon system.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Adds pre-game area denial without granting full mine-laying capability.

definition: A specialised ramming or breaching system that replaces part of the normal collision resolution with its own attack procedure.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Models purpose-built penetration equipment and alternative ram resolution.

definition: A special deployment method that places an aerial unit onto the battlefield away from enemies and marks it as newly arrived.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Provides deep deployment with arrival-state restrictions.

definition: A deployment ability that allows a previously placed unit to be removed and deployed again, potentially changing its deployment state.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Represents misinformation or feints by allowing placement decisions to be revised.

definition: A carrier facility that generates, launches or reallocates short-range aircraft or similar support assets.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Defines a parent platform's capacity to project subordinate aerial assets.

definition: A rule that replaces a destroyed vessel or model with a wreck or debris marker when space permits.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Turns destroyed units into persistent battlefield terrain or hazards.

definition: An action that projects troops from a unit onto a territory or objective where their presence can contest or score it.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Connects transport assets to persistent territorial control.

definition: A defensive aircraft capability that improves interception against incoming air attacks and may permit interception without an existing support formation.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Provides local anti-air protection through subordinate aircraft.

definition: A transport capability that allows an eligible reserve unit to arrive near the carrier instead of making its normal reserve arrival procedure.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Links reserve arrival to a transport platform.

definition: A support ability that adds friendly presence to, or removes enemy presence from, a nearby territory after movement.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Allows nearby platforms to influence an objective without conducting a full assault.

definition: A unit capability for placing minefield markers during deployment or play, normally subject to spacing and placement restrictions.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Creates persistent area-denial hazards rather than resolving an immediate attack.

definition: A parent platform that expands attachment capacity or allows associated units to enter play near it.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Makes one unit a deployment and force-organisation anchor for subordinate craft.

definition: A pass-through attack made against a model crossed during movement, resolving after the movement path creates the attack opportunity.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Couples movement path and attack eligibility.

definition: A support mission that allocates temporary supply tokens to nearby friendly units for later recovery or replenishment.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Models battlefield logistics as a discrete support action.

definition: The act of consuming an allocated supply resource to remove disruption or attempt to clear a depleted-ammunition state.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Turns logistics tokens into recovery of readiness or ammunition.

definition: A finite local reserve that can absorb depletion states from nearby units and later clear some of those stored depletion markers.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Represents limited local logistics capacity with an explicit exhaustion ceiling.

definition: A logistics procedure that moves an ammunition-depletion state from a supported unit onto a supply-bearing unit or stockpile.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Models ammunition redistribution separately from generic healing or repair.

definition: A reserve-arrival method that bypasses the normal arrival roll and permits flexible placement in exchange for temporary movement or action penalties.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Trades reliable deep arrival for reduced immediate effectiveness.

definition: A defensive mechanism where nearby models in the same unit contribute to the protection of the model being attacked.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Rewards formation integrity by pooling defensive capability.

definition: A support system that deploys a limited number of escort assets to nearby friendly units, subject to normal capacity limits.
usage_example_or_mechanical_role: Redistributes defensive subordinate assets during play.
